meta.title: Ivan Pavlov — Product Designer & Design Engineer
meta.description: Senior Product Designer and Design Engineer. Design systems, enterprise and fintech products used by millions.

about.label: (01) — About
about.text: Hi, I'm Ivan, a product designer who opens the code editor{code} as often as Figma. For 10+ years I've designed the unglamorous stuff: [enterprise suites](0), [transport apps](1){ticket}, [trading desks](3){spark} and the [design systems](2){toggle} underneath them. I like complexity that ends up feeling obvious{line}. Today I prototype in React, build with AI and ship my own small products. The best way to understand a handoff is to stand on both sides of it.

principle.label: Principle
principle.title: I speak code
principle.text: I prototype in React and review the front-end. Fewer revisions, cleaner handoff.

cases.name: Transneft
cases.before: Three internal products, three UI dialects
cases.after: one design system the whole suite ships on.
cases.did: Took all three from research to release, grew the design system to 50+ components and brought design review and AI tools into the process.

cases.name: Sber Troika
cases.after: a transport app 1.5M people open every day.
cases.did: Designed the Moya Troika app (iOS, Android) from zero: fare payment, top-ups and trips, plus its design system and the passenger web account.

cases.name: EPAM UUI
cases.after: tokens, variables and 4 themes across 20+ products.
cases.did: Built tokens, variables and theming into the UUI design system, from research and CJM to work with distributed teams.

cases.name: Nominex
cases.after: an exchange and a DEX on one shared UI kit.
cases.did: Designed trading, liquidity pools and farming, the interface architecture and the UI kit both products are built on.

cases.name: Mavfarm
cases.after: a mobile version that won Awwwards Site of the Day and FWA of the Day.
cases.did: Designed the mobile version at Geex Arts, in art director Slava Kornilov's team.
